name: basic-benchmark
description: 25 deterministic questions: math, facts, classification, strings

test_cases.input_text: What is 17 + 26? Answer with just the number.
What is 9 times 8? Answer with just the number.
What is 144 divided by 12? Answer with just the number.
What is 15% of 200? Answer with just the number.
What is the square root of 81? Answer with just the number.
What is 2 to the power of 10? Answer with just the number.
What is 100 minus 37? Answer with just the number.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 4, 8, 16? Answer with just the number.
What is the capital of France? Answer with just the city name.
What is the capital of Japan? Answer with just the city name.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer with just the symbol.
Which planet is closest to the Sun? Answer with just the planet name.
How many days are in a leap year? Answer with just the number.
Who wrote Romeo and Juliet? Answer with just the last name.
What is the largest ocean on Earth? Answer with just the ocean name, one word.
What is the chemical formula of water? Answer with just the formula.
How many continents are there? Answer with just the number.
What is the capital of Australia? Answer with just the city name.
Is the sentiment of this sentence positive or negative? 'I love this phone, it works great!' Answer with one word.
Is the sentiment of this sentence positive or negative? 'This was a terrible waste of money.' Answer with one word.
Is 29 a prime number? Answer yes or no.
Is 51 a prime number? Answer yes or no.
Is the word 'level' a palindrome? Answer yes or no.
Reverse the word 'stone'. Answer with just the reversed word.
How many letters are in the word 'banana'? Answer with just the number.
